hints.title: Index Bucket Mapping
hints.text: Group occurrences of each distinct value into an ordered list of indices during initialization.

hints.title: Range Boundary Lookups
hints.text: For a query range and value, locate the first index at or after left and the first index strictly greater than right.

hints.title: Frequency Count Difference
hints.text: The difference between the two index positions gives the exact frequency in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(log K) per query via bisect
complexity.space: O(N) storing occurrence indices grouped by value
complexity.notes: Indices for each value are sorted in increasing order, enabling binary search range queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through range [left, right] per query takes O(N * Q) and times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Mapping value to sorted list of indices reduces range frequency to two binary search lookups.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute bisect_right(indices, right) - bisect_left(indices, left).
